Manifest.Name: Simply Sour Cherry
Manifest.Description: Crimson jewels and midnight cherries hum from ancient branches, featuring original assets by Macskasajt. Their tart rubies and mystical Gypsy varieties birth sticky amber Gum, fragrant Leaves, and artisanal treasures—Pálinka that carries caravan songs, Gummy Wine with chewy mischief, Compote swimming in ruby syrup. Gus serves their enchanted Strudel, Sponge Cake, and Soup, each bite a summer festival. Rekindled lovingly for Stardew Valley 1.6, balanced, and all the wonder intact. Requires Platonic's Recipes for Water Bottle. 🍒✨
Manifest.Author: KennethFiel
